notes:
Added

  • The Pip-Boy can be your character sheet. It is now registered as a real Foundry sheet for character and robot actors, so any player who owns their character can pick it from Sheet Configuration and have it open on every click of their token or their name in the directory. It is not a default: nobody is switched over without choosing it.
    • A gear in the Pip-Boy's own top bar opens Sheet Configuration, because the casing hides the window header the gear normally lives in. Without it the Pip-Boy would be a one-way door — chosen as your sheet with no way back to the system's own.
    • The Token HUD button and the sheet are the same window: opening from the HUD routes through the document's sheet when the Pip-Boy is the sheet, so a character never ends up with two Pip-Boys on screen.
  • XP awards when a combat ends. Ending a combat totals the XP of the NPCs and creatures that were in it and opens a Vault-Tec tally for the GM, with the running total on the same mechanical reels the travel counter uses.
    • The XP per foe is the system's own derived reward value, from that NPC's level and category (minion / normal / mighty / legendary) — nothing new to fill in on a statblock.
    • Foes marked defeated are ticked by default; anything that fled or was talked down can be ticked back in, and the total re-spins as you go.
    • The award is split between the characters by default, or can go full to each; flipped per award or set as the default.
    • A chat card records who received what, and flags anyone who has just crossed their next-level threshold.

Full details in the release notes.
